errors.evidence: This sentence incorrectly describes the values for positions L1 and R1. At L1, all three models have a value of approximately 14. At R1, the values are approximately 10 for mBERT, 11 for XLM-R, and 9 for chLSTM. The description conflates values from different positions and incorrectly claims chLSTM has a 'slightly higher value (around 14)' when at L1 it is equal and at R1 it is lower.

errors.text_span: with chLSTM generally showing the highest values, followed by mBERT and then XLM-R
errors.evidence: This ordering of models by Shapley value (chLSTM > mBERT > XLM-R) is only true for the 'T' category. For most other categories, such as R1, L2, L4+, and R4+, the order is different (e.g., XLM-R > mBERT > chLSTM). Therefore, stating this is a general pattern is a significant over-generalization.
